senses.gloss:
a. 
__1 Bestowing enjoyment; राजा भोजो विराट् सम्राट् क्षत्रियो भूपतिर्नृपः [[Mb. 12. 68. 54.]] 
__2 Leading a life of enjoyment, enjoying; देवासुरमनुष्येषु ये भजन्त्यशिवं शिवम् । प्रायस्ते धनिनो भोजाः [[Bhāg. 10. 88. 1.]] 
__3 Liberal, bountiful.

[भुज्-अच्] N. of a celebrated king of Mālvā (or Dhārā); (supposed to have flourished about the end of the tenth or the beginning of the eleventh century, and to have been a great patron of Sanskrit [Page1213-1] learning; he is also supposed to have been the author of several learned works, such as सरस्वतीकण्ठाभरण &c.). 
__2 N. of a country. 
__3 N. of a king of the Vidarbhas; भोजेन दूतो रघवे विसृष्टः [[R. 5. 39]]; 7. 18, 29, 35. 
-जाः (m. pl.) N. of a people. 
-Comp. 
-अधिपः an epithet of 
__1 Kamsa. 
__2 Karṇa. 
-इन्द्रः a king of the Bhojas. 
-कटम् N. of a town founded by Rukmin. 
-कुलम् the dynasty of the Bhojas who ruled over the country of Vidarbha or Berar; अभोजयद् भोजकुलाङ्कुरः क्वचित् [[N. 16. 48.]] 
-देवः, -राजः king Bhoja; धन्यः श्रीभोजराजस्त्रिभुवनबिजयी [[Udb.]]; see (1) above. 
-पतिः 
__1 king Bhoja. 
__2 an epithet of Kamsa.

a. [भुज् णिच् ण्वुल्] 
__1 Causing to eat, feeding, nourishing; दैवे पित्र्ये च भोजकः [[Y. 2. 35.]] 
__2 An eater.

a. [भुज्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] 
__1 Feeding, nourishing, giving to eat. 
__2 Voracious; (राक्षसी) अङ्गारकेति विख्याता छायामाक्षिप्य भोजनी [[Rām. 4. 41. 26.]] 
-नः 
__1 N. of Viṣṇu. 
__2 Of Śiva. 
-नम् 
__1 Eating, eating food; taking one's meals; अजीर्णे भोजनं विषम्. 
__2 Food. 
__3 Giving (food) to eat, feeding. 
__4 Using, enjoying. 
__5 Any object of enjoyment. 
__6 That which is enjoyed; सहानुजैः प्रत्यवरुद्धभोजनः [[Bhāg. 1. 10. 1.]] 
__7 Property, wealth, possessions. 
-Comp. 
-अधिकारः charge of provender, superintendence over food or provisions, stewardship. 
-आच्छादनम् food and raiment; भोजनाच्छादने दद्यादृतुकाले च संगमम् [[Pt. 5. 62.]] 
-कालः, -वेला, -समयः meal-time, dinner or supper time. 
-त्यागः abstaining from food, fasting. 
-भाण्डम् a dish of meat. 
-भूमिः f. a dining-hall. 
-विशेषः a dainty, delicacy. 
-वृत्तिः f. a meal, food. 
-व्यग्र a. 
__1 engaged in eating. 
__2 straitened for want of food. 
-व्ययः expense for food.

a. [भुज् अनीयर्] 
__1 Eatable, edible. 
__2 To be fed, nourished (dependants). 
-यम् Food.
a. [भुज्-णिच्-तृच्] One who feeds, a feeder.

a. [भुज्-णिनि] (At the end of comp.) 
__1 Eating, enjoying; using, possessing &c. 
__2 Feeding, nourishing.

pot. p. [भुज्-ण्यत्] 
__1 To be eaten. 
__2 To be enjoyed or possessed. 
__3 To be suffered or experienced. 
__4 To be enjoyed carnally. 
-ज्यम् 
__1 Food, meal; त्वं भोक्ता अहं च भोज्यभूतः [[Pt. 2]]; [[Ku. 2. 15]]; [[Ms. 3. 240]]; भोज्यं भोजनशक्तिश्च रतिशक्तिर्नराः स्त्रियः [[Chāṇ.]] 
__2 A store of provisions, eatables; बर्धयेद्बाहुयुद्धार्थं भोज्यैः शारीरकेबलम् [[Śukra. 4. 877.]] 
__3 A dainty. 
__4 Enjoyment. 
__5 Advantage, profit. 
__6 Food given to the Manes. 
__7 Wounding the mortal spot (मर्मभेद); भोज्ये पांसुबिकर्षणे [[Mb. 5. 169. 12]] (com. भोज्ये कौटिल्ये मर्मपीडने). 
__8 A festive dinner, feast. 
-Comp. 
-अन्न a. one whose food may be eaten; एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्नाः [[Ms. 4. 253.]] 
-उष्ण a. too hot to be eaten. 
-कालः meal-time. 
-संभवः chyme, the primary juice of the body.

__1 A princess of the Bhojas; पूर्वानुशिष्टां निजगाद भोज्याम् [[R. 6. 59]]; 7. 2, 13. 
__2 A procuress.
